ideas.title: The Impact of NYPD Corruption on Community Trust
ideas.description: Investigate how the recent corruption allegations against NYPD officials are affecting community trust and relationships between law enforcement and the public.
questions: How do community members perceive the NYPD?
What are the long-term effects of corruption on community trust?
ideas.insight: The recent corruption allegations against NYPD officials have significant implications for community trust and relationships between law enforcement and the public. A deeper investigation into the impact on community members and the long-term effects of corruption is warranted.

ideas.title: The Scope of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the number of providers charged and the amount of money involved.
questions: How many providers have been charged with Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What is the total amount of money involved in the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: The recent charges against multiple providers in Minnesota highlight the need for a closer look at the scope of Medicaid fraud in the state. A thorough investigation into the number of providers charged and the amount of money involved is necessary to understand the full extent of the issue.
